description: Split packages/runner/src/actions/github-pr.ts (scc Complexity 384 / 1379 lines) into cohesive collaborating modules by concern, behavior-preserving. Three registered actions collapse to thin orchestrators; the gh failure-text classifier matrix, gh output parsers, check-rollup classification, mutable runner runtime, merge-pipeline state machine, and issue-field bridge each become focused modules behind a re-export barrel. Action IDs, output JSON field shape/order, GitHubPrErrorCode values, git/gh command strings + sequence, step-recorder names, and the four setGitHubPr*ForTest setter signatures remain identical.

tasks.title: Extract pure leaf modules (types, parse, checks) and start the barrel
tasks.description: Create three pure, dependency-free leaf modules and move their functions/types verbatim out of the monolith. (1) github-pr-types.ts: GitHubPrErrorCode value set, GitHubPrStep, and the three *Output interfaces — interface property order preserved byte-for-byte so JSON.stringify output is identical. (2) github-pr-parse.ts: parsePrList, parsePrListWithDraft, parsePrView, parsePrViewWithDraft, parsePrViewInternal, extractPrNumberFromUrl, combinedGhOutput, errorMessage. (3) github-pr-checks.ts: PrCheckEntry, parsePrStatusCheckRollup (+ result parser), classifyRollupBucket, classifyPrChecks, formatFailedCheck. github-pr.ts switches to importing these and re-exporting them so every existing caller (registry.ts, the three specs, internal helpers still in github-pr.ts) compiles unchanged. This is phase 1 of the design migration (pure leaves only — the classifier matrix is T-002).
acceptanceCriteria: github-pr-types.ts, github-pr-parse.ts, github-pr-checks.ts exist under packages/runner/src/actions/ and contain the relocated symbols verbatim.
The three *Output interfaces retain their exact declaration-order properties (byte-identical JSON.stringify).
github-pr.ts re-exports the relocated symbols so registry.ts and the three spec files compile with NO import-line edit.
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner exits 0 (no import cycle; DAG leaf layer clean).

npm test -w packages/runner is green — create-github-pr.spec.ts, merge-github-pr.spec.ts, mark-github-pr-ready.spec.ts pass unchanged, including exact git/gh command-string and output-JSON assertions.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/github-pr-types.ts, github-pr-parse.ts, github-pr-checks.ts created; github-pr.ts re-exports them; typecheck + full runner test suite green.
tasks.notes: Leaf modules must stay pure (no internal deps, no mutable state) so they are trivially unit-testable. Do NOT move the classifier matrix or any mutable runner here — those are T-002/T-003.

tasks.title: Extract gh failure-text classifier module + add direct unit tests for the matcher matrix
tasks.spec: packages/runner/tests/merge-github-pr.spec.ts (existing indirect coverage); openspec/changes/issue-308/design.md#D5 (new direct coverage requirement)
tasks.description: Create github-pr-classify.ts and move the classifier matrix verbatim: classifyGhFailure, classifyPushFailure, and the five matchers looksLikeBaseMoved / looksLikeProtectionConflict / looksLikePrStateConflict / looksLikeAuthFailure / looksLikeRetrySafe (depends only on github-pr-types.ts from T-001). Then add packages/runner/tests/github-pr-classify.spec.ts with exhaustive, direct phrase-set coverage for each looksLike* matcher (today only looksLikeRetrySafe has dense ~15-phrase coverage; the other four are exercised only sparsely via orchestrators), plus classifyGhFailure precedence (auth → protection → base-moved → pr-state → retry-safe) and the empty-text → retry-safe fallback. github-pr.ts re-exports the classifier symbols. Pure-function unit tests — no git/gh/network.
acceptanceCriteria: github-pr-classify.ts exists and exports classifyGhFailure, classifyPushFailure, and the five looksLike* matchers, behavior-identical to the originals.
packages/runner/tests/github-pr-classify.spec.ts directly asserts every documented phrase for each of the five looksLike* matchers.
classifyGhFailure precedence is pinned: auth-failure beats protection beats base-moved beats pr-state beats retry-safe; empty/blank input classifies as retry-safe.
github-pr.ts re-exports the classifier symbols so existing callers compile unchanged.
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner exits 0.
npm test -w packages/runner is green, including the new github-pr-classify.spec.ts AND the three existing action specs unchanged.
tasks.notes: Matchers move verbatim (same toLowerCase() idiom, same phrase lists) — this task only relocates them and adds the missing direct coverage called out in AC #1 of the issue. Do not 'improve' the phrase sets; that is a Non-Goal.

tasks.title: Extract shared runner runtime module (git/gh singletons + setters + runGhPrecheck)
tasks.description: Create github-pr-runtime.ts as the single owner of the mutable git/gh runner instances, exposing getGitHubPrGit() / getGitHubPrGh() getters and the setGitHubPrGitRunnerForTest / setGitHubPrGhRunnerForTest setters (design D2). Use getters — not exported mutable `let` bindings — so a setter reset (e.g. setGitHubPrGhRunnerForTest(null)) is always observed by helpers reading the runner live. Also relocate runGhPrecheck here (the git/gh execution context; consumes combinedGhOutput from github-pr-parse.ts). Helpers keep their existing runner *parameter* signatures; only the orchestrator entry points (still in github-pr.ts at this stage) call the getter once and thread the runner into helpers. github-pr.ts re-exports the two runner setters so the three specs keep injecting via the same path.
acceptanceCriteria: github-pr-runtime.ts is the single source of truth for the git and gh runner instances; getGitHubPrGit()/getGitHubPrGh() always return the live value set by the setters.
setGitHubPrGitRunnerForTest and setGitHubPrGhRunnerForTest keep their exact names and signatures and remain importable from ./github-pr.js (barrel re-export).
One setGitHubPrGhRunnerForTest call sets the single gh runner read by all paths (create/merge/mark) — no per-module duplicate setters.
runGhPrecheck lives in github-pr-runtime.ts and behaves identically.
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner exits 0.
npm test -w packages/runner is green — the three action specs pass unchanged with their existing setter-injection patterns.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/github-pr-runtime.ts created; orchestrators obtain runners via getters; github-pr.ts re-exports setters; typecheck + runner suite green.
tasks.notes: The timing/retry knobs (setGitHubPrChecksTimingForTest / setGitHubPrTransientRetryForTest) are NOT moved here — they belong to the merge pipeline (T-004) which is their sole consumer. If review prefers runGhPrecheck isolated, a dedicated github-pr-gh.ts is an acceptable variant (design Open Questions) — behavior identical either way.

tasks.title: Extract merge-pipeline state machine module (owns checks-timing + transient-retry knobs)
tasks.spec: packages/runner/tests/merge-github-pr.spec.ts (exact git/gh command-string, step-name, and sequence assertions)
tasks.description: Create github-pr-merge.ts and move the merge-pipeline state machine verbatim: waitChecksAndMergePr, waitForPrChecks (PR-state short-circuit → check-rollup poll loop → mergeStateStatus re-confirm → gh pr merge --squash → post-merge MERGED confirm), mergeStateStatusFailure, runGhReadWithRetry, delayWithSignal, and the WaitChecksAndMergeOk/Failure result types. This module owns setGitHubPrChecksTimingForTest and setGitHubPrTransientRetryForTest because those knobs are consumed nowhere else (design D1/D2). It depends on github-pr-runtime (getters + runGhPrecheck), github-pr-classify, github-pr-parse, github-pr-checks, and github-pr-types. github-pr.ts re-exports the two timing/retry setters and the merge entry so specs and the merge orchestrator compile unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: github-pr-merge.ts owns the full merge state machine and the two timing/retry test knobs; no other module mutates them.
git/gh command strings and their sequence are byte-identical (gh-precheck → git-push → gh-pr-list → gh-pr-create → gh-pr-checks poll → gh-pr-merge → gh-pr-view-confirm).
Every step-recorder step name is preserved verbatim.
setGitHubPrChecksTimingForTest and setGitHubPrTransientRetryForTest keep exact names/signatures and remain reachable via ./github-pr.js.
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner exits 0.
npm test -w packages/runner is green — merge-github-pr.spec.ts passes unchanged, including its exact command-string, step-name, and output-JSON assertions.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/github-pr-merge.ts created; github-pr.ts re-exports merge entry + two timing/retry setters; typecheck + runner suite green.
tasks.notes: This is the highest-risk extraction (hot-path real gh pr merge). Rely on merge-github-pr.spec.ts's exact command/step assertions as the regression guard — they must stay green at every commit.

tasks.title: Extract issue-field bridge + split three orchestrators; collapse github-pr.ts to a pure barrel
tasks.spec: packages/runner/tests/create-github-pr.spec.ts + merge-github-pr.spec.ts + mark-github-pr-ready.spec.ts (full behavior guards, import lines UNCHANGED)
tasks.description: Final phase of the design migration. (1) Create github-pr-issue-fields.ts: resolveCreatePrText, resolveMergeSubject, validateIssueFieldSource, loadIssueFields, resolveIssueFieldValue, requiredIssueFields (depends on the shared issue-fields action + errorMessage from github-pr-parse). (2) Create create-github-pr.ts: createGitHubPrAction + the git-ref probes openOrReusePr / resolveCurrentBranch / resolveBaseSha (only the create path touches git) + BaseShaOk/Failure + buildCreateGitHubPrOutput adapter (moved verbatim, output field order preserved). (3) Create merge-github-pr.ts: mergeGitHubPrAction + resolvePrNumberForMerge + buildMergeGitHubPrOutput. (4) Create mark-github-pr-ready.ts: markGitHubPrReadyAction + markReadyOutput. (5) github-pr.ts collapses to a pure re-export barrel: the three *Action entry points + the four setGitHubPr*ForTest setters (design D3). registry.ts is not touched.
acceptanceCriteria: github-pr-issue-fields.ts, create-github-pr.ts, merge-github-pr.ts, mark-github-pr-ready.ts exist with the relocated symbols.
github-pr.ts is a pure barrel (only re-exports) — no business logic remains in it.
registry.ts:9-13 import of the three actions from ./github-pr.js is unchanged and resolves.
The three spec files' import lines are UNCHANGED — they still import actions + setters from ../src/actions/github-pr.js (barrel transparency, design D3).
git-ref probes live in create-github-pr.ts; output adapters live in their respective orchestrators with byte-identical field order.
No import cycle (tsc --noEmit clean); npm run typecheck -w packages/runner exits 0.

npm test -w packages/runner is green — all three action specs (~30 cases, incl. exact-command-string + step-name + output-JSON assertions) pass, and github-pr-classify.spec.ts from T-002 still passes.
Final gate passed: confirm via grep/diff that no spec file's import line for github-pr.js changed.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/github-pr-issue-fields.ts, create-github-pr.ts, merge-github-pr.ts, mark-github-pr-ready.ts created; github-pr.ts is a pure barrel; typecheck + full runner suite green; zero spec import-line churn.
tasks.notes: This task also satisfies the design's phase-6 final gate (full typecheck + test + no-spec-import-changed verification). After T-005, the original 1379-line monolith is fully decomposed into the D1 module layout.
